role.zh: 聯合創辦人 | 認證小顏矯正師 / 導師

bio.en:
Teresa is the co-founder of Shugaosha and the Australian Representative of the Japan Small Face Correction Association. After completing advanced training in Japan, she became a certified trainer and has dedicated herself to restoring natural facial balance through gentle, hands-on techniques.

Committed to excellence in both treatment and education, Teresa continues to refine The Shugaosha Way while upholding the highest standards of care, professionalism and continuous learning.
bio.zh:
Teresa 是 Shugaosha 的聯合創辦人及日本小顏矯正協會的澳洲代表。在日本完成進階培訓後，她成為認證導師，並致力於透過溫和的手法恢復自然的面部平衡。

Teresa 致力於在治療和教育方面追求卓越，在秉持護理、專業和持續學習的最高標準的同時，不斷完善 The Shugaosha Way。

role.zh: 聯合創辦人 | 認證小顏矯正師 / 導師

bio.en:
Charles is the co-founder of Shugaosha and is dedicated to restoring natural facial balance through gentle, hands-on techniques. Every treatment is thoughtfully tailored to the individual, creating a calm, comfortable and personalised experience.

Committed to the values of The Shugaosha Way, Charles strives to provide professional care with consistency, respect and genuine attention to every client’s individual needs.
bio.zh:
Charles 是 Shugaosha 的聯合創辦人，致力於透過溫和的手法恢復自然的面部平衡。每一次治療都是針對個人精心量身定制，營造出寧靜、舒適和個性化的體驗。

Charles 秉承 The Shugaosha Way 的價值觀，力求以一致、尊重和真誠的態度關注每位客戶的個人需求，提供專業的護理。
